mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, we have clear skies over Badger Ridge Middle School and a full moon tonight. The ISS is scheduled to fly over this evening, but unfortunately, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Construction update for Hwy M near the Aldi site continues with a full closure planned from October 5 through October 7 for paving work. Also, the Planning Department reminds everyone that the city does not accept fee payments online or via wire transfer, so please only use checks delivered to City Hall.
We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run today, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights at local spots like Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company early next week.

In a report covering September 5, officers noted an unusual incident where several vehicles had cheese slices placed on their windshields as part of a viral social media trend, resulting in no damage.
It is a great day to visit Culver's because the flavor of the day is Turtle. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
